name: XLE_REGISTRATIONS_
description: XLE_REGISTRATIONS contains the detailed registration information of legal entities and establishments, such as registration number, place of registration, and legal address.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the registration.

columns.name: REGISTERED_NAME
columns.description: Registration name.

columns.name: ALTERNATE_REGISTERED_NAME
columns.description: Registration alternate name.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Source table name for the information, either XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES or XLE_ETB_PROFILES.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the registered legal entity or establishment.

columns.name: JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Geographic area or areas for which a legal authority is responsible. Foreign key to XLE_JURISDICTIONS_B table.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Registration number against a tax regime.

columns.name: PLACE_OF_REGISTRATION
columns.description: Registration place of registration.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Date on which a task, event or business process begins. Use for date enabled entities for which histories are not stored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Date that a task, event, or business process ends. Use for date enabled entities that histories are not stored for.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location identifier of the registered address.

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Issuing legal authority identifier.

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Issuing legal authority site identifier.

columns.name: IDENTIFYING_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag for identifying registration.
